title: The Mystery of Cloud Nine

scenes.text: A galaxy discovered with zero stars shocked astronomers
It contains no visible stars, only dark matter and gas
scenes.label: NO VISIBLE STARS

scenes.text: Its dark‑matter halo is roughly the size of the Milky Way’s
scenes.label: MILKY WAY‑SIZED HALO

scenes.text: Astronomers identified it using data from the Dark Energy Survey
scenes.label: DISCOVERED BY DES

scenes.text: Follow for the science they never taught you.

description: The Cloud‑9 galaxy is a real, star‑less system that challenges our view of how galaxies form. Follow for daily science!
